coverage.scope: One verified text-to-QR → Android PNG export → image re-import → exact payload decode round-trip; not a claim about every barcode format or camera input

scenes.title: Read an image. Make a QR.
scenes.caption: Start with an existing image or create a code from your own text. This app uses image input.
scenes.observed: Final installed APK home screenshot, visually inspected; Read image and Create QR modes visible. No live camera input.

scenes.title: Write your payload
scenes.caption: Enter the text, then generate a QR with the unchanged ZXing core.
scenes.observed: Raw host video seconds 50–66 shows typed synthetic URL https://example.org/oritwig-codes and Preview QR generating the result.
scenes.sourceAvailability: Original retained as verification evidence; not distributed in this repository

scenes.title: Preview the code
scenes.caption: The 33-character payload becomes a 1,024 × 1,024 PNG QR, ready to save.
scenes.observed: Final screenshot visibly shows the exact payload, QR preview, 1024×1024 PNG label, ZXing and correction level M.

scenes.title: Save a portable PNG
scenes.caption: Name the file in Android’s save picker. The exported PNG was independently checked.
scenes.observed: Raw host video seconds 163–173 shows naming codes-final.png and the Save action. Later actual export is present and independently decoded; SHA-256 is recorded in exportVerification.
scenes.sourceAvailability: Original retained as verification evidence; not distributed in this repository

scenes.title: Open the exported image
scenes.caption: Choose codes-final.png through Android Files to read it back.
scenes.observed: Final Android image-picker screenshot shows actual codes-final.png with 7.56 KB size. Subsequent action log selects this exact exported PNG.

scenes.title: Review the exact result
scenes.caption: The same 33-character payload returns as QR CODE / URI. Nothing is opened automatically.
scenes.observed: Final result screenshot shows QR CODE / URI / Characters:33 and exactly https://example.org/oritwig-codes. Actual exported PNG independently decoded to that same payload.

gallery.title: Image reader and QR maker
gallery.caption: Choose between reading an image and creating a QR.
gallery.observed: Final APK home screen; no camera workflow.

gallery.title: Text and generated QR
gallery.caption: The input payload and its generated QR are visible together.
gallery.observed: Final APK QR preview shows exact input, QR and PNG dimensions.

gallery.title: Android PNG export
gallery.caption: Choose the destination and filename in Android Files.
gallery.observed: Final APK create-document picker; raw video subsequently names codes-final.png and invokes Save. Exported bytes are independently verified.

gallery.title: Re-import the saved PNG
gallery.caption: The actual exported codes-final.png appears in Android Files.
gallery.observed: Final APK image picker shows codes-final.png, selected by the next recorded UI action.

gallery.title: Exact decoded result
gallery.caption: The exported image decodes to the original 33-character payload.
gallery.observed: Final APK displays exact payload and QR CODE/URI classification.

limits: Image input only; live camera scanning is not implemented.
Recorded excerpts and later genuine screenshots are edited together; this is not a continuous recording.
Android API35 runtime, physical devices and every barcode format are not covered by this demo.
